## Who I am

I'm an AI/ML engineer who likes building things that real people use. Most of my recent work is
on applied LLM systems: agents that call tools against real business data, retrieval pipelines,
and the evaluation and safety work needed to trust them in production.

## How I work

- I start from the user's problem and the data, not from the model.
- I measure: retrieval recall, latency, cost per conversation, and failure cases.
- I write boring, well-tested backend code around the exciting model code.

## What I'm looking for

Roles where I can own an AI feature end to end — from prototyping and evaluation to deployment
and monitoring. I'm open to remote work and relocation.
